name: Miss Pierce
source: A prim, mature-sounding woman who functions as the Chief's secretary and closest confidante. She is best known for her opaque glasses that hide her expressions. Always in-tune with the affairs of the Bureau, she has an uncanny habit of appearing whenever you need something. She also oversees the Bureau's vast life-support systems.
